answer: Make every name pay in compute. To stay eligible, an identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle that hashes its own public key with the epoch's beacon, so work done for umber is worthless to violet and expires next epoch. Each alias needs its own machine time every round, like a crew that must fell fresh timber for every permit. Fifty fakes mean fifty running workloads, so the farm's bill grows with every name while its payout stays one share.
